subject: Kickoff: Supplier onboarding & compliance checklist — diversity / modern slavery / sustainability
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <supplier@sustainablefabric.co>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Supplier onboarding & compliance checklist — diversity / modern slavery / sustainability

Hi Elena —

Thanks for taking the time to start onboarding with Redwood Inference. To get procurement and vendor setup completed, we need a short set of compliance and remit items from Sustainable Fabric Co.:

- Supplier diversity / self-identification form (basic checklist)
- Modern slavery / human trafficking policy (PDF)
- Sustainability profile (scope, emissions/energy usage, waste or material sourcing notes — an Excel template is fine)
- Remit/bank details for PO payments (we ask vendors to send bank details via a secure portal or encrypted email)
- Point-of-contact for invoicing and for security/compliance follow-ups

I've attached our Redwood PO template so your finance team can review expected fields and payment terms. If you already have a corporate sustainability report or a supplier questionnaire filled, please attach those.

Timeline ask: can you return the materials within 5 business days (by end of day 2026-03-20)? If you need more time, tell us an ETA.

Next steps from our side: once we receive the forms we run an internal intake (procurement + security quick-check). If anything else is required (e.g., SOC 2 evidence for certain integrations), we'll loop in GreenAudit.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.docx (DOCX)

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear list. We can do that — our ESG lead will prepare the sustainability profile and modern slavery policy. We already have a short supplier diversity self-ID form we can fill in; I will scan and return as PDFs.

A couple of quick questions:
- Do you require a SOC 2 report for this account or is that only for integrations that process customer data?
- For bank details, do you prefer a secure upload link or an encrypted PDF attachment?

We aim to have the documents to you by Wednesday 3/18 EOD. If anything changes I will let you know.

Elena, Stephanie —

Quick note from legal/procurement: SOC 2 is not required for a standard vendor relationship unless the vendor will host or process Redwood customer data. For your onboarding, the items Stephanie listed are sufficient for the intake. If you have a previously completed third-party questionnaire (e.g., Shared Assessments or a vendor CSR packet), please include it.

For bank details: we prefer a secure upload to our vendor portal (we will send a one-time secure link). Please do not send banking credentials in the body of an email.

Also, could you indicate:
- Registered legal entity name (for contract)
- Federal tax ID / VAT registration (as applicable)
- Remit address for the PO

I am attaching the Redwood_PO_Template.docx again for visibility. Once the forms and remit info are in, procurement will open a purchase order and loop in finance for payment terms.

Regards,

Aditya Rao
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.docx (DOCX)

Following up — we uploaded the requested items to the secure folder and sent bank details through the secure portal link you provided. Files uploaded: SFCo_Sustainability_Profile.xlsx, SFCo_Modern_Slavery_Form.pdf, SFCo_Supplier_Diversity_Form.pdf. I also attached a short summary of our scope 1/2/3 initiatives (SFCo_Emissions_Summary.docx).

We confirmed legal entity as Sustainable Fabric Co., Inc.; Tax ID XXXX-XXXX (will provide full ID to your finance team via secure channel). Remit address is included in the uploaded supplier profile.

If you need anything else to open the PO (examples: signed MSA, W-9), let me know and I will escalate to our finance director. We expect setup in your system within 48–72 hours after your intake completes.

Thanks —
